plugins.name: guided-coding-mentor
plugins.description: Senior engineering mentor for deliberate coding practice: you write and verify every line, gated on explaining it before you advance

plugins.name: academic-research-hs
plugins.description: Multi-agent academic research pipeline hard-wired to home-still: deep-research + academic-paper + academic-paper-reviewer + academic-pipeline orchestrator + home-still-bridge routing skill with snowballing protocol, with every literature search and integrity gate routed through the home-still local corpus (distill_search, catalog_*, paper_get, paper_download) before web APIs.

plugins.name: research-to-flashcards
plugins.description: Turn research into spaced-repetition flashcards in Mochi: retrieve source material via home-still, distill it into atomic tenets, get human approval, then push to the Mochi API (kebab-case keys, one-concurrent-request limit, duplicate-safe re-runs).

plugins.name: procedural-animation-assets
plugins.description: Take any Blender-modeled asset and make it procedurally animatable in a game engine: choose the technique (morph / skeletal+drivers / vertex-shader / physics / spline / runtime-mesh-gen), author it through BlenderMCP, export to glTF, and drive it in-engine — at any polygon budget.
